papers.abstract: While Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) are rapidly advancing toward generalist robot policies, quantitatively characterizing their capability boundaries and failure modes remains challenging. To address this, we introduce VLA-Arena, a comprehensive benchmark. It features a novel structured task design framework to quantify difficulty across three orthogonal axes: (1) Task Structure, (2) Language Command, and (3) Visual Observation. This allows us to systematically design tasks with fine-grained difficulty levels, enabling a precise measurement of model capability frontiers. For task structure, VLA-Arena comprises 11 task suites organized into four dimensions: Safety, Distractor, Extrapolation, and Long Horizon, totaling 170 tasks. Each suite spans three difficulty levels (L0-L2), with fine-tuning restricted to L0 to rigorously assess generalization. Orthogonal to this, language (W0-W4) and visual (V0-V4) perturbations can be applied to any task as diagnostic probes to distinguish robust grounding from superficial pattern matching. Our extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art VLAs reveals critical limitations: memorization over generalization, superficial visual perception, and a neglect of safety constraints. Additionally, model rank reversals across L0-L2 validate that each level provides non-redundant insights. To foster research addressing these model limitations and ensure reproducibility, we provide the complete VLA-Arena framework, including an end-to-end toolchain from task definition to automated evaluation and the VLA-Arena-S/M/L datasets for fine-tuning. Our benchmark, datasets, models, and leaderboard are publicly available at https://vla-arena.github.io.

analysis.key_results: 当前SOTA VLA模型显示出记忆化而非泛化、浅层视觉感知、忽视安全约束等关键局限；L0-L2间模型排名反转表明各级别提供非冗余洞见。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入一个综合基准VLA-Arena，采用新的结构化任务设计框架，从任务结构、语言命令和视觉观察三个正交轴量化难度，并公开完整的框架、数据集与排行榜。
analysis.method: 设计包含11个任务套件（170个任务）的基准，覆盖安全、干扰、外推和长程四个维度，每套任务三个难度级别（L0-L2），并在语言（W0-W4）和视觉（V0-V4）上施加扰动探针，仅用L0数据进行微调以测试泛化能力。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出VLA-Arena基准，通过结构化任务设计系统量化VLA模型的能力边界与失效模式。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接聚焦于VLA模型的评测与能力分析，属于本站核心主题，为VLA模型的短板和改进方向提供系统性诊断工具。

papers.abstract: End-to-end image controllers that map raw camera frames directly to control actions are increasingly deployed in safety-critical systems. However, formally verifying their closed-loop behavior remains an open challenge because cameras produce high-dimensional images whose generation cannot easily be described in a closed mathematical form. We propose a Deterministic World Model (DWM), a latent-free neural decoder that maps physical states (e.g., position and velocity) directly to synthetic camera images, enabling closed-loop reachability analysis without the overapproximation caused by stochastic latent variables. The DWM is trained with a novel dual loss combining saliency-map reconstruction and a control-consistent term that preserves behavioral consistency with the real controller. We integrate the DWM into closed-loop reachability analysis and apply conformal prediction to inflate the reachable sets by a distribution-free trajectory-tube deviation bound, transferring the surrogate guarantee to the real system with high probability. Experiments on a CARLA braking system and three Gym benchmarks (CartPole, MountainCar, Pendulum) show that the DWM produces substantially tighter reachable tubes than a cGAN and trajectory predictor baselines while meeting the target coverage after conformal inflation.

analysis.key_results: 在CARLA制动系统和三个Gym基准（CartPole、MountainCar、Pendulum）上，DWM产生的可达管比cGAN和轨迹预测基线更紧致，并在保形膨胀后满足目标覆盖率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种确定性世界模型（DWM），实现从物理状态到合成相机图像的无隐变量映射，并结合闭环可达性分析与保形预测，为端到端视觉控制器提供形式化安全保证。
analysis.method: 提出确定性世界模型（DWM），是一种无隐变量的神经解码器，通过结合显著图重建损失和控制一致性项的双重损失训练；将其集成到闭环可达性分析中，并应用保形预测通过无分布轨迹管偏差界膨胀可达集。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种无需隐变量的确定性世界模型，直接将物理状态映射为相机图像，用于端到端视觉控制器的闭环可达性分析，并通过保形预测将替代系统保证传递到真实系统。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作与本站的WAM主题高度相关，因为它专门提出了一种用于视觉控制器的确定性世界模型，为机器人安全验证和仿真提供了新方法。
